Iron Mountain itself was founded in 1951 as Iron Mountain Atomic Storage Corporation by Herman Knaust, a former mushroom entrepreneur who had purchased a depleted iron ore mine near Kingston, New York, went public in 1996, became a real estate investment trust in 2014, and as of 2023 is headquartered in Portsmouth, New Hampshire. Given no second, independent source corroborates the geocoded address, and this row does not fit the Hayden Rd cluster pattern found for its siblings, it is not applied, consistent with this projects standard that a geocoding services own confidence score is not itself external corroboration.
